result.summary: Found 1 issue: the Smash Bros Burgers card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows an unformatted 'NaN' value instead of a delivery fee. The rest of the page looks visually consistent.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel reads '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee. This points to a failed numeric parse or missing data being rendered directly. It looks broken and leaves users unsure what delivery will cost.
issues.suggestion: Validate the delivery fee before rendering. If it is missing or invalid, hide the fee line or show a fallback such as 'Delivery fee unavailable'. Also fix the upstream data or calculation so a valid fee is returned.
